n01.roman: Ye sirf kalpana hai, ek fan theory! Koi asli game ya elaan nahi.

n02.roman: Pehla zone: Marine Drive. Raat mein street lights ki chamakti maala, jise Queen's Necklace kehte hain. Night drive, perfect!

n03.roman: Side mission: peak time mein local train pakdo! Game ka sabse mushkil level.

n04.roman: Par twist! Yahan sabse bada dushman police nahi, traffic jam hai! Wanted level full, aur gaadi ek inch bhi na hile!

n05.roman: Aur mausam? Monsoon mode! Sadkon par paani, aur car ki jagah naav wala mission!

n06.roman: Final mission: Bandra-Worli Sea Link par, samandar ke upar chase!
